label: Quiet Home
prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: isolated Picture This! ESL vocabulary-card cutout
Primary request: Create this single subject, and no others: An older person sits alone beside a phone in a modest Rajshahi home..
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for later removal.
Subject: An older person sits alone beside a phone in a modest Rajshahi home.; recognizable at a glance and appropriate for the printed label ‘Quiet Home’.
Meaning and focal priority: Show the decisive moment of the action, with this evidence dominant: An older person sits alone beside a phone in a modest Rajshahi home.. Use a tight partial-person cutout when it makes the action clearer; show the full body only when the complete pose is essential.
Place and material culture: contemporary Rajshahi, Bangladesh. Depict this specific visible local detail as part of the action: an older resident in a modest Rajshahi home and courtyard with a protective street gate and locally typical clothing. People should look Bangladeshi and wear ordinary current local clothing. Every depicted woman must wear either a three-piece shalwar kameez with an orna or a burka; do not depict a woman in jeans, a sari, or Western dress. Men may wear ordinary shirts and trousers, panjabi, or lungi as fits the setting. Use locally plausible vehicles, buildings, shop fittings, objects, and colors; no generic Western sedans, European streets, or invented landmark signs. Keep the place cues subordinate to the labeled action.
Style/medium: clean realistic educational photo cutout; natural saturated color and bright even lighting, with a cohesive contemporary Bangladeshi visual register.
Composition/framing: square canvas; one centered compact action vignette; all action-defining hands, face, limbs, props, and interactions visible; the focal action fills about 70 percent of the frame; comfortable outer padding.
Constraints: the background is one uniform #ff00ff color with no variation; keep the complete coherent cutout separated from the background; crisp edges; exactly one vocabulary concept; no text, label, logo, border, watermark, cast shadow, contact shadow, reflection, floor plane, texture, or scenery; do not use magenta, fuchsia, hot-pink, or purple hues anywhere in the subject.
Avoid: tiny full-body figures, distant poses, generic standing people, unrelated props, duplicate views, collage layout, captions, and isolated body parts without enough context. Physical plausibility is essential: each person has exactly two arms, one anatomically correct hand per arm, natural finger positions, and no arm or finger passing through a solid object. Props must rest on a surface or be held naturally; nothing floats in the air unless the action explicitly calls for it. Keep any window protected by a metal grille. When a person reads or uses a phone, place the camera behind or beside that person's shoulder: the phone display must face both their eyes and the viewer. Never show a screen facing the viewer while its user looks at the phone's back. Never put a notification on the phone's back.
